note: What a share card quotes from a story (src/lib/markdown/sharePassages.ts; read by sharePassages.test.ts on the web and by the apps' share-card twins). The story's first `limits.readChars` UTF-16 units (one less when the last would split a surrogate pair) are read as CommonMark without GFM, block by block in reading order: every paragraph, at the top level and inside quotes and list items. Headings, code, thematic breaks and HTML are skipped, and so is a paragraph that is only pictures, a standalone link (soleLinkParagraphs: it gets a link card) or an embedded card ([title](/card/…) alone in its paragraph). A block's text is plainText; a block under `limits.minGraphemes` graphemes is dropped; at most `limits.max` blocks are read. `opening`: the blocks joined by \n, cut at `limits.maxGraphemes` graphemes with "…". `UPDATE_SHARE_PASSAGES=1 npx vitest run src/lib/markdown/sharePassages.test.ts` writes each case's opening.
